content.title: Free ICO Converter & Favicon Generator
content.p1: Creating a website? You need a favicon - that little icon that appears in browser tabs.
content.p2: Our ICO Converter transforms any PNG or JPG image into a standard Microsoft `.ico` file. We support all common favicon sizes to ensure your brand looks sharp on every device.

features.title: Key Features
features.f1_desc: Choose from 16x16, 32x32, 48x48, 64x64, or 128x128 pixels. Or select all!
features.f2_desc: Upload a large logo, and we'll automatically downscale it smoothly to fit the tiny icon format.
features.f3_desc: Modern .ico files can contain multiple sizes in one file. We handle that for you.

how_to.title: Steps to Create Favicon
how_to.step1_desc: Use a square image (PNG/JPG) for best results.

why.title: Why .ICO format?
why.p1: While modern browsers support PNG favicons, the `.ico` format is still the standard for maximum compatibility across all operating systems and legacy browsers (like Internet Explorer).
